items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Topics 58:1
items.html: (to the question) In the third year, the lower joint of the Netzah of Tevuna enters, and within it the Netzah of the five Hassadim of Aba, and they enter within the Sefira of Hochma of ZA. And in the fourth year, the Hod of the five Hassadim enters in the lower joint of the Hod of Tevuna, within the Sefira of Bina of ZA. And in the fifth year, the Hesed of the five Hassadim enters in the middle joint of the Netzah of Tevuna, within the Sefira of Hochma of ZA; and then the Netzah of the five Hassadim descends within the Sefira of Hesed of ZA. And in the sixth year, the Gevura of the five Hassadim, which is within the middle joint of the Hod of Tevuna, enters within the Bina of ZA; and then the Hod descends from there within the Sefira of Gevura of ZA. And in the seventh year, on the first day of the year, the Tifferet of the five Hassadim, which is within the crown of the Yesod of Tevuna, enters within the Sefira of Daat of ZA; and ZA then becomes in the age of the young children, for a part of Daat entered in him. And in the continuation of the seventh year until the eighth and one day, the Hochma of the five Hassadim, which is in the upper joint of the Netzah of Tevuna, enters within the Sefira of Hochma of ZA, and from there the Hesed of the five Hassadim descends into the Hesed of ZA, and the Netzah of the five Hassadim, which was there, now descends to the Sefira of Netzah of ZA; and the right line is completed entirely. And in the eighth year and one day, the Bina of the five Hassadim, which is in the upper joint of the Hod of Tevuna, enters within the Sefira of Bina of ZA, and from there the Gevura of the five Hassadim descends into the Sefira of Gevura of ZA, and the Hod of the five Hassadim, which was there, now descends to the Hod of ZA; and the left line is completed. And in the ninth year and one day, the Daat of the five Hassadim, which is within the Yesod of Tevuna, enters within the Sefira of Daat of ZA, and from there the Tifferet of the five Hassadim descends into the upper third of the Tifferet of ZA, up to the Chazeh; and the middle line is also completed. (Part 1, Page 166, Items 123 to 127).
